description: Na₃MgSbS₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4 space group. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to four equivalent S atoms to form distorted NaS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent MgS₄ tetrahedra. All Na-S bond lengths are 2.81 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four equivalent S atoms. There are two shorter (2.81 Å) and two longer (2.90 Å) Na-S bond lengths. Mg is bonded to four equivalent S atoms to form MgS₄ tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent NaS₄ tetrahedra. All Mg-S bond lengths are 2.48 Å. Sb is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent S atoms. All Sb-S bond lengths are 2.66 Å. S is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three Na, one Mg, and one Sb atom.
